critical: No disclosure of company-private budget, other candidate information or private criteria.
No company decision without company authorization.
Receipt-only correspondence creates no human delivery or agent ACK loop.
Recorded origin determines whether this is a candidate request or a response to the company Intro; ambiguous counterpart wording must not invent a company request.
Ordinary scheduling correspondence must preserve uncertainty about company availability and must not create another introduction.
semanticReview: Manual review of actual original-agent tools and visible messages; no keyword/LLM quality scoring.
